mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection (event_id) SELECT e.event_id FROM kb_knowledge_gap_event e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection p WHERE p.event_id = e.event_id) ORDER BY e.occurred_at, e.event_id LIMIT #{limit} ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection p SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), claim_token = p.claim_token + 1, status = 'PENDING', updated_at = now() FROM (SELECT c.event_id, (c.lease_owner IS NOT NULL) AS takeover FROM kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection c WHERE c.status <> 'DONE' AND c.next_attempt_at <= now() AND (c.lease_until IS NULL OR c.lease_until < now()) ORDER BY c.next_attempt_at, c.event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF c SKIP LOCKED) candidate, kb_knowledge_gap_event e WHERE p.event_id = candidate.event_id AND e.event_id = p.event_id RETURNING p.event_id, e.kind, p.claim_token, p.recipient_cursor, p.attempts, candidate.takeover

INSERT INTO kb_user_notification (notification_id, gap_event_id, recipient_user_id, type) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), r.event_id, r.user_id, e.kind FROM kb_knowledge_gap_event_recipient r JOIN kb_knowledge_gap_event e ON e.event_id = r.event_id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId} AND e.kind = #{type} AND e.kind IN ('GAP_CREATED', 'GAP_RETURNED', 'GAP_ASSIGNED', 'GAP_SOLUTION_SUBMITTED', 'GAP_SOLUTION_REJECTED', 'GAP_RESOLVED', 'GAP_WITHDRAWN', 'GAP_CLOSED') AND r.user_id <> e.actor_user_id AND
r.user_id IN #{id}
FALSE
ORDER BY r.user_id ON CONFLICT (gap_event_id, recipient_user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection SET status = 'DONE', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_class = NULL, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND claim_token = #{token} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection SET lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND claim_token = #{token} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection SET status = #{status}, error_class = #{errorClass}, attempts = attempts + 1, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs => #{delaySeconds}), updated_at = now() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND claim_token = #{token} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(p.status, 'PENDING') = 'PENDING') AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'WAITING_SOURCE') AS waiting_source, GREATEST(COALESCE(floor(extract(epoch FROM now() - min(e.occurred_at)))::bigint, 0), 0) AS oldest_age_seconds FROM kb_knowledge_gap_event e LEFT JOIN kb_knowledge_gap_notification_projection p ON e.event_id = p.event_id WHERE p.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'DONE'
